maddeler.e:
أوتال (form VIII)
# أُوتَالُ (ʔūtālu) /ʔuː.taː.lu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِئْتَالَ (iʔtāla)
# أُوتَالَ (ʔūtāla) /ʔuː.taː.la/: first-person singular non-past passive subjunctive of اِئْتَالَ (iʔtāla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
